title: NVIDIA Xid 69 (graphics engine class error)
hint: The GPU rejected a command recorded by the game. Often caused by one of the environment / VKD3D flags in use: if the crash goes away with them removed, use “Find the breaking setting” to narrow it down.

title: NVIDIA Xid error
hint: A GPU fault reported by the NVIDIA kernel driver. Look the number up in NVIDIA's Xid table.

title: GPU device lost
hint: The game lost its GPU device (hang or reset). Check the kernel log for an Xid at the same time.

title: Streamline Reflex / frame generation errors
hint: Also logged thousands of times in runs that exited cleanly, so on their own they do not explain a crash.
